Supreme Court of the United States 
1 First Street, N.E. 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

November 27, 2018 

Re:  PDR Network, LLC et al. v. Carlton & Harris Chiropractic, Inc., 

No. 17-1705, Consent Request for Extension of Time 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

The Court granted the petition for a writ of certiorari in the above-captioned 
case on November 13, 2018.  Under the Court’s rules, petitioners’ brief on the merits 
is currently due December 28, 2018. 

Because  of  scheduling  conflicts  created  by  ongoing  litigation  matters,  and 
taking into consideration upcoming religious observances, petitioners hereby request 
an  11-day  extension  of  time  in  which  to  file  petitioners’  merits  brief  and  the  joint 
appendix.  Respondent has expressly consented to this extension of time. 

Pursuant  to  Rule  30.4  of  the  Rules  of  this  Court  and  subject  to  the  Court’s 

approval, we propose the following briefing schedule: 

Petitioners’ Merits Brief and Joint Appendix: Tuesday, January 8, 2019 
Respondents’ Merits Brief:  

 Thursday, February 7, 2019 

Respectfully submitted, 

/s/ Jeffrey N. Rosenthal 

Jeffrey N. Rosenthal 
Counsel of Record for Petitioners
